normative_basis.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files, v5.4.1
normative_basis.finding: Format bit 0x01 selects kGeneral. The reviewed section does not define 0x02 as an empty-value flag or assign semantics to other bits.

peer_source_audit.observation: CadValue.IsEmpty maps the least significant flag bit (0x01) to empty.
The current reader consumes the data-type BL before gating the payload on IsEmpty.
TABLE_value_fields consumes the data-type BL and skips the payload when either low bit is set.

scope.change: The reader returns Unsupported before interpreting any format bits other than documented 0x01, leaving the enclosing FIELD as an incomplete bounded shell. The typed writer rejects modern format masks containing bits outside 0x01 before output.

generated_control.inputs: Valid in-memory FIELD frames with only the root CadValue format field patched to 0x02, 0x03, or 0x04.
assertions: AC1021 and AC1024 readers keep each unqualified flag value in an incomplete FIELD shell without publishing a typed value or child values.
Constructed typed FIELD writers refuse flags 0x02, 0x03, and 0x04 before body, string, or handle output.
The documented 0x01 kGeneral route and existing kUnknown incomplete/refusal controls still pass.
